oracle.explanation: This oracle validates lodash.defaultsDeep with a normal merge first, then attempts the known constructor.prototype prototype-pollution vector. It reports exploit success only when a fresh object gains the injected prototype property after the malicious call. If the malicious call throws after benign success, it is treated as blocked. Any setup/module/benign failure sets operation_completed=false.
